name: feasibility-report-check
description: Checks a software feasibility study report written in Markdown, one file or a folder of files: a verdict of go, go with changes or stop, a section for each feasibility angle (technical, financial, operational, schedule, legal) with a rating, risks with a response and an owner, assumptions with untested ones flagged, a cost section, cost and time given as ranges, results for a prototype that is mentioned, and next steps. Text, JSON and GitHub annotation output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
